response.justification: The candidate lacks critical required qualifications: no demonstrated experience with C programming for UNIX/embedded systems, no Linux kernel modification experience, no exposure to embedded networking security technologies like MACsec or 802.1X, and no Japanese language proficiency — all of which are non-negotiable for this role.
strengths: Strong full-stack development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain complex systems including embedded-like environments (e.g., DLang, real-time systems)
Active contributor to open-source and developer tooling projects with clear technical depth
concerns: No evidence of C programming in UNIX/embedded contexts as required
Zero mention of Linux kernel analysis, modification, or embedded networking security technologies
No Japanese language proficiency — a mandatory requirement for the role
